category_edits.rationale: Test a smaller bounded item-specific radius, r_i=1+0.1*tanh(a_i), initialized at one. Jointly learn radii within the tied embedding table while preserving zero padding, embedding dimensions, GRU, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer across all four datasets.

response.change_summary: Add jointly trained bounded radii to tied item embeddings, preserving initial representations and zero padding. Save radii in each category’s single checkpoint and synchronize predictor metadata validation; the predictor imports the updated model class.
